heading: Why MATRIKS?
subheading: You've got options. Here's why teams choose to work with us.

items.title: Built for Results
items.description: Every project starts with one question: what measurable outcome do you need? We build towards that, not feature lists.

items.title: Weeks, Not Months
items.description: Your first working prototype arrives in days. Full projects launch in 2-4 weeks. We move fast because your time matters.

items.title: Clear Pricing
items.description: No surprise invoices. No scope creep fees. You know exactly what you're paying before we write a single line of code.

items.title: We Dig Into Problems
items.description: Half the work is understanding what's actually broken. We ask the uncomfortable questions so we build the right thing.

items.title: Your Own Dashboard
items.description: Track progress, leave feedback, approve changes — all in one place. No back-and-forth emails or lost Slack messages.

items.title: Direct Access
items.description: Talk directly to the people building your project. No account managers, no middlemen, no broken telephone.
